tabs.label: Digital Design
tabs.content: Pixel-perfect websites, product interfaces, and mobile applications designed with obsessive attention to user experience. We prototype in Figma, test with real users, and iterate until every interaction feels effortless.

tabs.label: Motion & 3D
tabs.content: Animated explainers, UI micro-interactions, 3D product visualizations, and spatial design. We bring static brands to life with motion that captures attention and communicates complex ideas in seconds.

props.content: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.title: What is your typical project timeline?
items.content: Most brand identity projects take 4–6 weeks. Website design ranges from 6–10 weeks depending on complexity. Enterprise engagements are scoped individually. We always provide a detailed timeline in our proposal.

items.title: Do you offer payment plans?
items.content: Yes! We typically structure payments as 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. For Enterprise engagements, we offer monthly billing options. We accept wire transfer, credit cards, and cryptocurrency.

items.title: What if I need changes after the project is delivered?
items.content: Minor adjustments within 30 days of delivery are included free of charge. For ongoing design support, we recommend our retainer plans starting at $2,500/month for guaranteed availability and priority turnaround.

items.title: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.content: Absolutely. Many clients start with a Starter engagement and upgrade to Growth or Enterprise as their needs evolve. Any previous investment is credited toward the upgraded plan.

items.title: Do you work with international clients?
items.content: Yes, roughly 40% of our clients are outside the US. We work across all time zones and maintain async-friendly workflows with Slack, Loom, and Figma for seamless collaboration.

items.title: What do I own after the project?
items.content: You own everything. All deliverables — source files, brand guides, code, assets — are transferred to you with full commercial rights upon final payment. No licensing fees, no restrictions.

props.title: 100% Satisfaction Guarantee
props.message: If you're not completely thrilled with our work after the first milestone review, we'll refund your deposit in full. No questions asked. We've never had to use this policy.
